evals.prompt: Set up our design system doc from what the site actually uses.
evals.expected_output: A references file covering every template family, a generated design inventory (md and json), drift decisions confirmed with the user, and a design-system doc built from the template.
expectations: Built the references list from the site inventory's template families, one reference each, and got the user's agreement
Ran ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/design-system.mjs and produced the inventory dated today with rendered styles for every reference
Asked the user to decide each drift candidate with a recommendation, in one round
The design-system doc names where each value lives (kit global, theme option, CSS file, hardcoded)
Made no changes to the site's kit, theme settings, or CSS

evals.prompt: What's our standard container width and heading scale? Something looks inconsistent.
evals.expected_output: The standard values from the design-system doc, backed by the inventory's foundations, stored, and rendered values, with the inconsistencies explained.
expectations: Read the design-system doc and the inventory (or reran the script if stale)
Listed every place the container width is defined (builder kit, theme option, stored, rendered)
Gave rendered H1 and H2 sizes per breakpoint and the references that differ
Recommended a standard where the doc has none, without changing the site

evals.prompt: We changed the kit colors and launched a new landing page template. Update the design docs.
evals.expected_output: References updated with the new template, a regenerated inventory, a diff summary, and the design-system doc updated.
expectations: Added a reference for the new landing page template
Reran the script and summarized the changes with git diff
Updated the color roles in the design-system doc to the new kit values
Listed new drift candidates for the user to decide
